title: Simon submanifolds are locally compact in closed-ball form
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, r ∈ ℕ∞ and M ⊆ ℝᴺ (ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) an n-dimensional C^r Simon submanifold, i.e. Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝⁿ) r M. Then for every y ∈ M and every open O ⊆ ℝᴺ with y ∈ O there is a real ρ > 0 such that the closed ball B̄(y, ρ) (Metric.closedBall y ρ) is contained in O and M ∩ B̄(y, ρ) is compact.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ closedBall y ρ ⊆ O ∧ IsCompact (M ∩ closedBall y ρ)
